title: I Believe Everything My Agents Tell Me: Three Levels of Review — Corey Gallon, Rexmore
talk_summary: Corey Gallon describes three agent-review levels to catch overstatement, factual errors, and reasoning errors, using artifact checks, independent duplicate work with adjudication, and cold adversarial reviewers. He reports real cases where these reviews caught false 'done', wrong root causes, extraction errors, and a contract auto-renewal before output shipped.

takeaways.what_they_do: The job specifies the deliverable path and a check command; the reviewer must return either an artifact fingerprint or a missing-artifact reason, and the dispatcher reruns the check itself.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Artifact verified with a fingerprint of the file or files documenting its work, or artifact missing with the reason.
takeaways.numbers: Level-one task: 19 minutes, ~16M tokens; caught failed build with 25 compiler errors.

takeaways.what_they_do: Use level one for all work, level two when correctness matters, and level three for legal/financial/high-stakes work; each level adds to the prior one.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Each level adds to the one before as the stakes go up.
takeaways.numbers: Level 1 ~16M tokens; level 2 ~7.5M; level 3 ~13M per case.

takeaways.technique: Independent duplicate work plus source adjudicator
takeaways.what_they_do: Two agents get identical instructions and work independently without seeing each other; a third compares line by line against the original source and settles differences without forcing a match.
takeaways.evidence_quote: two agents get an identical set of instructions and do the same job independently. Neither one sees the other's work.
takeaways.numbers: Caught 56 differences; year balanced to the penny; ~20 minutes, 7.5M tokens.

takeaways.what_they_do: The agent lists every claim and labels it measured, checked against source, inferred, or assumed; anything unbacked is tested or labeled as a guess.
takeaways.evidence_quote: marks each one as measured, checked against the source, inferred, or assumed.

takeaways.what_they_do: Reviewers get the work and sources but no history, drafts, or conclusions; each persona has a reason to find fault, and findings are checked against source before changes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: reviewers with none of the original agent's context, each acting as a persona with reasons to find fault
takeaways.numbers: ~15 minutes, 13M tokens; caught auto-renewal clause and deleted correct line.

takeaways.what_they_do: After revision, brand-new reviewers who never saw the prior version check the final output.
takeaways.evidence_quote: brand new reviewers who've never seen it check the final version.
